source.title: Soft and elastic hydrogel-based microelectronics for localized low-voltage neuromodulation

material: PEDOT:PSS electrically conductive hydrogel (ECH/MECH) from ionic liquid ion gel after water exchange

formulation.evidence: Approximately 50wt% of ionic liquid versus PEDOT:PSS was added to PEDOT:PSS aqueous solution (0.172 g in 15ml of PH1000 solution)

processing.evidence: spun coated on SiO2, PFPE or PDMS substrate at a speed of 2,000 r.p.m. for 1min
the film was soaked in a copious amount of deionized water (Millipore water purification system) for over 24h

youngs_modulus.evidence: values of the ECH were estimated to be 32±5.1 kPa when measured via compression tests

conductivity.evidence: Our ECH has an electrical conductivity of 47.4±1.2 S cm−1

swelling_ratio.evidence: with a swelling ratio of 2.1 when sandwiched by the elastic PFPE-DMA

description.evidence: the ECH maintained its high CSC value after 19 days of incubation, with less than 4.3% change

duration_days.evidence: the ECH maintained its high CSC value after 19 days of incubation, with less than 4.3% change

other_outcomes.evidence: the ECH showed a CSC of 164 mCcm−2
other_outcomes.name: charge storage capacity

other_outcomes.evidence: We also calculated a capacitance of 9,800µFcm−2
other_outcomes.name: capacitance (areal)

other_outcomes.evidence: the MECH electrode showed a current density of 1,359mAcm−2 under a bipolar pulsed voltage of 0.5V at 50Hz
other_outcomes.name: current density at 0.5 V bipolar pulse, 50 Hz

other_outcomes.evidence: leg response at an ultralow voltage of 50mV
other_outcomes.name: leg response stimulation voltage in vivo

other_outcomes.evidence: leaving it inside the freely moving mice for 6 weeks
other_outcomes.name: implantation duration around sciatic nerve

notes: Hydrated in water/DMEM/PBS. Water content ~82 wt% within 1 min soaking. Biocompatibility: no significant change in neurofilament/S-100 vs sham; inflammatory area comparable to sham.
